output.reason: On its own, the cited item [ev-771c9eba4819] is just a metric name. However, it appears in the list under the section introduction [ev-1f419676f177], and that introduction states the change directly. Loki metrics that start with `cortex_` will now start with `loki_`, so this metric becomes `loki_ring_oldest_member_timestamp`. Exposure depends on `metrics_namespace` keeping its default of `loki`: setting it to `cortex` keeps the old prefix, but that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. The consequence is that queries, dashboards and alerts that use the `cortex_` name no longer match the new name, which is enough for an engineer to write the subject, change, applicability and consequence.
